source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Note all reported outputs, inputs, and emissions comparisons.
3. Note any other alarming observations, such as unexplained odors.
4. Document the data in a form acceptable to the courts.  Graphs work well:

  ![graphs](graphs.png "graphs from our data analysis")

5. Identify outliers. See if the factory has reported the issue.
6. Assess the risk, and then notify the appropriate authorities.

If you disagree with the results, or if the neighbours seem fine with all of this,
please let the authorities know. If you're having a hard time, contact your
local lawyer, or give me a call.

# How to ensure an accurate air-quality report includes a proper emissions comparison.

First, you have to establish a baseline or base time period, then compare present-day outputs and emissions to that baseline. This will ensure you have a proper emissions comparison, and therefore proper air
